finland-s-htp-value-which-employers-1t1q: Finland''s HTP value, which employers must take into account, is lower: 0.05 mg/m³.
latvia-s-law-gives-this-limit-1wvuaxj: Latvia''s law gives this limit for the inhalable fraction of the dust.
dust-masks-in-japan-pass-a-1yvkm6r: Dust masks in Japan pass a national test (国家検定). DS masks are disposable and RS masks take replaceable filters; class 2 filters at least 95.0% of the test particles, class 3 at least 99.9%.
tu-rkiye-has-not-adopted-the-11m2j0x: Türkiye has not adopted the EU''s binding limit (Directive (EU) 2017/2398). Tridymite has the same limit as cristobalite: half the value for quartz.
tu-rkiye-s-rules-for-protective-thzk4t: Türkiye''s rules for protective equipment follow the EU''s (Regulation (EU) 2016/425).
this-is-an-exposure-standard-employers-1: This is an exposure standard (노출기준): employers must measure the dust at work and act when it is over the standard, but crystalline silica is not among Korea''s binding limits (허용기준).
dust-masks-for-work-in-korea-s8e7ic: Dust masks for work in Korea (방진마스크) carry the KOSHA safety certification mark (안전인증). A 1급 filtering-facepiece mask filters at least 94.0% of the test particles, a 특급 one at least 99.0%. KF94 masks are health masks approved by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, not certified dust masks for work.
until-31-december-2026-the-limit-1l2w1ex: Until 31 December 2026 the limit is for the whole respirable dust when it holds 10% or more crystalline silica (quartz, cristobalite, tridymite or diatomite), and dust with less is held to 1 mg/m³. From 1 January 2027 the limit is for the crystalline silica itself.
disposable-dust-masks-in-taiwan-are-13vq: Disposable dust masks in Taiwan are graded under the national standard CNS 14755 (拋棄式防塵口罩).
tridymite-s-limit-is-the-same-1gu6h6l: Tridymite''s limit is the same as cristobalite''s.
malaysia-s-guidelines-use-the-us-1axxdoc: Malaysia''s guidelines use the US (NIOSH) classes, and also accept masks certified to the Australian and New Zealand (AS/NZS 1716), European (EN 149), Korean and Japanese standards.
these-limits-are-for-the-whole-hbokaz: These limits are for the whole respirable dust (呼尘), not only the silica in it. Any dust with 10% free silica or more is held to them.
dust-masks-in-china-are-graded-1vdx5wt: Dust masks in China are graded under the national standard GB 2626-2019. KN masks are for dust that is not oily, such as glaze dust.
tridymite-has-the-same-limit-as-1shcxmu: Tridymite has the same limit as cristobalite: half the value for quartz. The Standards count a working week of 48 hours. Read in the Internet Archive''s copy of the Department of Labor and Employment''s own file, as its site could not be read.
this-limit-is-for-the-free-9amjv4: This limit is for the free silica in the respirable dust: to compare a measurement with it, multiply the dust''s concentration by the share of free silica in the dust. The free silica in all the dust breathed in is limited to 0.3 mg/m³. Read in a legal database''s copy of the regulation, as the government''s own page could not be read.
vietnam-s-national-standard-for-filterin: Vietnam''s national standard for filtering half masks, TCVN 13409:2021, is the European standard EN 149.
pieces-first-sold-before-1-december-1wdx: Pieces first sold before 1 December 2026 under the old rules may be sold until stocks run out.
a-cup-or-mug-must-meet-13iki3j: A cup or mug must meet both the limit for its rim and the limit for pieces that can be filled.
austria-also-limits-zinc-antimony-and-go: Austria also limits zinc, antimony and barium.
these-limits-are-for-imported-ware-18xl8: These limits are for imported ware; we found no official limit for ware made in Australia.
cooking-ware-means-pieces-made-mainly-1j: Cooking ware means pieces made mainly for cooking over a direct flame, in an oven or in a microwave. Pieces warmed in hot water or used at no more than 100 °C, such as sake warmers (tokkuri) and chawanmushi cups, are not cooking ware, nor are pieces only for reheating in a microwave. These limits date from 2008. The standards, kept by the Consumer Affairs Agency since 2024, were revised in 2025 without changing them: the revision applies from 1 June 2025 and its changes to specifications and test methods from 1 June 2026, and ware sold, made or imported before 1 June 2030 may still follow the earlier rules.
at-least-three-samples-are-tested-dficvw: At least three samples are tested: the ware passes if their average is within the limit and no single sample is more than 50% over it.
singapore-s-rule-gives-limits-for-1pzzw5: Singapore''s rule gives limits for lead only; cadmium falls under its general ban on vessels that can impart lead, cadmium or any other toxic substance.
cooking-ware-means-ceramic-ware-meant-lv: Cooking ware means ceramic ware meant to be heated, conventionally or in a microwave.
the-same-piece-is-tested-three-17q3ghz: The same piece is tested three times, each time for 24 hours in fresh 4% acetic acid, and the third result is held to the limit. Ware already on the market has until 30 June 2027 to comply.
the-law-gives-every-limit-in-sv74ap: The law gives every limit in milligrams per litre of the test solution, the shallow pieces'' too.
the-regulation-names-a-test-method-1pdkx: The regulation names a test method (TCVN 7146-1:2002, the same as ISO 6486-1:1999) but allows others of the same accuracy.
cooking-ware-is-tested-hot-two-1q5qa3v: Cooking ware is tested hot, two hours in 4% acetic acid at 98 °C, while other pieces stand 24 hours at 22 °C (pieces for the microwave, 15 minutes at 100 °C), so its limits cannot be compared with the other rows or with other countries'' cooking ware. Read in the standard''s issued text on the site of a Guangdong provincial regulator, as the national database could not be reached.
the-centre-for-food-safety-wrote-rzkaax: The Centre for Food Safety wrote in 2009 that Hong Kong has no specific law on materials that touch food, and we found no later change. Food sold must be fit to eat (Cap. 132), and food containers for home use come under the Consumer Goods Safety Ordinance (Cap. 456), but neither gives figures for lead or cadmium.
sells-to-private-buyers-in-germany-10bqx: Sells to private buyers in Germany only.
orders-by-quote-or-in-the-plkiwi: Orders by quote, or in the shop.
orders-by-form-without-a-cart-pqvm3c: Orders by form, without a cart.
orders-by-phone-or-email-from-15gr0rm: Orders by phone or email, from a price list.
orders-by-email-from-a-price-1fm0gf9: Orders by email, from a price list.
ask-the-shop-whether-an-item-64c6w2: Ask the shop whether an item is in stock before buying.
ready-made-glazes-and-clay-no-v849gz: Ready-made glazes and clay; no raw materials seen.
